# HitPrace.cz AI / crawler policy
#
# Search/indexing: allowed.
# Real-time AI grounding/input: allowed.
# Foundation-model training: disallowed where the provider exposes
# a separate crawler/control.
#
# The authoritative machine-readable Content Signal value is shared
# with the origin HTTP Content-Signal header.

User-agent: *
Content-signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /firma/
Disallow: /profil/
Disallow: /apply/
Disallow: /_automatika/
Disallow: /webservices/

User-agent: GPTBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: ClaudeBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: Amazonbot
Disallow: /

User-agent: CCBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: Bytespider
Disallow: /

User-agent: Applebot-Extended
Disallow: /

Sitemap: https://www.hitprace.cz/sitemap.xml
